description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This Suzuki OEM part that fastens onto the window frame and connects to the windshield frame to the door rail.
Comes in pairs (LH & RH).
Comes Primed in Gray
NOTE: These Brackets only require a “one screw” mount to the Windshield Frame (The old style required a “two screw” mount. This is done to leave room for installing a Hard-Top and the necessary mounting latches (which will use those holes) . It also works fine with a Soft Top and it allows you to easily switch back and forth from a Hard Top to a Soft Top. When you are using the Soft Top you will have one screw hole that is unused unless you have the Hard Top Mounting Latch installed.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Door Rail Mounting Bracket – RH
Qty 1 – Door Rail Mounting Bracket – LH
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
